screens.name: home
differences: desktop: The built page has a larger headline that wraps to three lines, where the mockup's headline wraps to two. This comes from the real headline text being longer, so it is a data difference and not a layout change.

desktop: The built page has slightly different vertical positions. The header sits higher (y≈57 vs 82) and the footer sits lower (y≈758 vs 742). The buttons are a bit taller. The header, hero and footer are in the same order and structure.
desktop: The secondary button background looks slightly lighter in the built page than in the mockup. This is a very small colour difference.
mobile: The subheadline is set in a larger font in the build than in the mockup.
mobile: The secondary button's background is a slightly lighter fill in the build; the mockup draws it nearly transparent.
mobile: The hero block starts higher in the build and the buttons are a little taller, so vertical spacing differs by a few pixels.
mobile: The footer note wraps onto two lines in the build, which moves the footer links up slightly. The longer text comes from real data, so this is not counted as a difference.
